content: {"summary":"The fraud‑scorer pods were OOMKilled twice on a 16‑core node in November 2025 because their in‑process feature cache grew unchecked when the redis‑features store became slow, pushing RSS close to the container limit.","likely_cause":"Unbounded growth of the in‑process feature cache triggered by latency spikes in redis‑features (FRD‑W118 warnings).","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"OOMKills coincided with redis‑features latency spikes.","evidence_ids":["RB-006#2"],"quote":"mostly when redis-features latency spikes (big key scans, BGSAVE on the single node)."},{"text":"The feature cache grows without bound when redis‑features is slow.","evidence_ids":["RB-006#0"],"quote":"in-process feature cache grows without bound when redis-features is slow"},{"text":"Tracemalloc showed the feature cache as the fastest‑growing allocation site.","evidence_ids":["INC-0013#2"],"quote":"the fastest-growing allocation site was in the feature cache."},{"text":"Both pods experienced OOMKilled events on the same evening.","evidence_ids":["INC-0097#1"],"quote":"Second `OOMKilled` on fraud-scorer-02."}],"next_checks":["Monitor FRD-W118 warning frequency and redis‑features latency during peak periods","Inspect feature cache size and add a hard cap or eviction policy","Review pod resource limits and consider lowering GOMAXPROCS to container limits","Set up alerts for rapid RSS creep on fraud‑scorer pods","Validate that thread counts are scoped to container cores, not node cores"]}
